text:
Maya (People Ops): Quick heads up — tomorrow at 11am we have a small visitor wave: two partners and one person dropping off a BIKE BOX for the demo team. Can we borrow the lobby tablet kiosk for self check-in + selfie badge?

Jon: Yes please. Is the kiosk the one on the right by the plants?

Maya (People Ops): Yep, that one. Would like to enable selfie capture so the guest badges have photos — less back-and-forth for the front desk.

Aisha: Love the selfie idea. Heads up though the badge printer jammed yesterday; Liam fixed it but we should have a backup sticker printer ready.

Liam (Front Desk): I can bring the backup printer to the lobby at 10:30 and set the kiosk on 'guest mode'. I moved the extra printer to the supply closet A yesterday.

Jon: Any special instructions for the bike box? Oversized deliveries usually go to the loading bay then to the locker area.

Maya (People Ops): The delivery ETA is 10:40, courier will ask for "Front Desk — Demo Team". If it fits, please put it in Locker 7. If not, we have the folding rack in the bike room.

Liam (Front Desk): Roger. Will keep Locker 7 reserved from 10:30–12:30. If it doesn't fit there, I'll flag @facilities.

checkin-bot: Reminder: kiosk software v2.1.4 is scheduled to restart at 3am for security patches. No impact tomorrow morning.

Aisha: Quick checklist for tomorrow?

Maya (People Ops): Short checklist: 1) Reserve kiosk + enable selfie mode, 2) backup sticker printer in lobby, 3) Locker 7 cleared and reserved, 4) front desk has visitor names and passes, 5) set two spare chairs in meeting nook C.

Jon: I'll bring 2 small folding chairs and a power strip for the demo team.

Liam (Front Desk): Also adding a sticky note on the main desk: "BIKE BOX incoming 10:40 — please ring bell" :bell:

Aisha: tiny favor — can someone take a quick photo of Locker 7 size so courier knows if box will fit?

Jon: On it. I’ll snap and drop in #photos in 5.

Maya (People Ops): Thanks! If anyone wants to volunteer to greet at 10:45 when the guests arrive, ping me. Non-urgent but appreciated. :raised_hands:

Liam (Front Desk): I'll be there. Also leaving a note in the guest calendar that badges will be printed with selfie photos.

Aisha: One more: if the courier leaves the box with concierge, please take a quick photo and mark the package as "fragile" in the package tracker.

Maya (People Ops): Agreed. Okay team — sounds like we’re covered. I’ll update the visitor event with the check-in flow and assignees. :white_check_mark:

Jon: Thanks — and if the photo badge auto-save fails, Liam, would you be able to manually attach a photo to the guest profile?

Liam (Front Desk): Yep. I also put a spare lanyard set in the top drawer for tomorrow.

checkin-bot: Log: kiosk mode changed to GUEST by Liam at 10:32 (simulated in thread).

Maya (People Ops): Perfect. See you all tomorrow.

[attachment: photo of Locker 7 uploaded by Jon to #photos]
